item.title: APM44 Bridge 0.12.7
item.description:
## 0.12.7 - 2026-09-05
- Reduced shared-memory audio transfer overhead by copying contiguous ring spans instead of calculating wraparound for every frame. Audio quality, buffering settings, and validation are unchanged. - Added repeatable transfer benchmarks and stronger tests for stereo ordering, wraparound, and partial transfers. - Added an isolated development app launch and fixed verification with custom build directories and fresh worktrees. - Added an opt-in workaround for Xcode 26.6 compiler discovery stalls, preserving compiler diagnostics and failure reporting.
